full_page.content:
1924, August
FR. SOLANUS NOTEBOOK NO. 1
Page 14 Cont.
Aug. 23 Cornelius 0'Donnell 30 Model printer away from Mother and silent and no trace found of him since June 1919. Enrolled to-day for year by one who just heard of his case - Mary Mccarthy
26 Vance Edw'd Bourke (22 1106 S. Washington, Royal Oak) now at St. Joseph's Retreat Dearborn 4 Mo with disease of brain. Enrolled To-day a perpetual member.
28 Louis Belleau (57 only son - well raised - address not known) away from Holy Sacraments ten yrs and from wife about Eleven. Enrolled To-day for one year.
29 Frank Paul Maniaci (38 - 2538 McDugell Ave) very careless in prac- ticing religion - Enrolled for yr
30 Mrs. Clara Kowalski (23 of 3392 Palmer Ave) extremely anxious lest x-ray Examination demand operation for dead bone in Ear joins Mass Assoc. This was Aug. 18. Aug. 30th - Today nothing was found as yet in photo x-r. -- Sept 1st Danger disapering, good color return- ing
Nov. 1 (1925) perfectly cured. Deo Grat.
Page 15 Sept. 1 John Wilkowski (35 4243 Russell St. ) been away from Wife and child 10 yrs. next March - last time 4 yrs ago wrote card.
3rd Martha Trocke (32 of 2580 Palmer Ave) cripple or very weak till a- bout 12 yrs of age disapointed in longing - desire to join Sisters about 15 years ago, Now ten years in Eloise Asylum. Enrolled to- day as birth-day present.
5 B. Stieber and Wife (E. Boulevard) Estranged Enroled for year Aug. 20th
7th Protestant Women Enrolled for Sake of Peace by Catholic Neighbor. Mrs. H. Johnson & Emma Smith running Scientific Beauty & Corsett Shop very much at variance Each having lawyer to the scandal of surroundings -- Papers already served in Court -- Sept. 12 Ami- cable settlement effected. Deo Gr
8 Thomas O'Connor (20 - 8038 Sprague Ave. ) twice tapped for dropsey, bad color very patient and resigned to God's will, Enrolled for year.
